name: Claw of the Old Ones
rules: +6 AP (no armour save), Parry (1)
basis: Sword (Parry 1) with User +1 like Morning Star/Flail; book 'no armour save' has no sheet analogue so set to an AP high enough to ignore any armour.

name: Sunstaff
rules: +2 to hit (Accurate), +6 AP (no armour save)
basis: Bow-range (24") S4 missile like Crossbow; book Accurate +1 to hit doubled to +2, no armour save as +6 AP.

name: Sun Gauntlet
rules: H2H, +2 to hit (Accurate), +6 AP (no armour save), extra S4 attack each round of hand-to-hand, no save
basis: Pistol-class (12" like Dueling Pistol, H2H) with Accurate +1 to hit doubled; book no-save as +6 AP.

name: Tufenk
rules: Reload (2), Steady Aim (move or shoot), +3 AP
basis: Rules not printed in the PDF; guessed as a cheap primitive gun modelled on Blunderbuss/Handgun, S3, 16", AP between Crossbow and Handgun.

name: Katar
rules: None
basis: Rules not printed; punch dagger modelled on Dagger/Club at 5 gc, Strength as user with no AP.

name: Katana
rules: +1 AP, Parry (1)
basis: No rules text found; Sword (Parry 1) with +1 AP for a finer edge, priced 20 gc vs Sword 10.

name: Cathayan longsword
rules: +1 AP, Parry (2)
basis: No rules text found; premium blade modelled on Rapier (Parry 2) plus Katana's +1 AP and User +1 as Morning Star.

name: Quarter staff
rules: Parry (1), +2 Initiative in close combat (Balanced), Freestyle (combines with bare-hand attacks, still gaining +1 Attack)
basis: Staff held in two hands with no AP; Parry (1) like Sword/Buckler and book +1 I doubled to +2.

name: Chain sticks
rules: Flurry (+2 Attacks in the first turn of each hand-to-hand combat, otherwise counts as two hand weapons)
basis: No AP in the book; Flurry attacks do not double (Attacks are not doubled); modelled as a Pair weapon like Weeping Blades.

name: Fish-hook shot
rules: Skirmish (no pen move), Precise (may target enemies in close combat; useless if the monk is in close combat), Knockdown (on hit target takes a Strength check or is knocked down, +2 vs large models; a mount knocked down makes the rider fall)
basis: Thrown weapon like Net/Bolas (no range/move penalties) at book range 3" and S3; +1 to test doubled to +2.

name: Steel whip
rules: Cannot be parried, Whipcrack (+1 Attack when the wielder charges; +1 Attack striking first against the charger when charged; max +1 Attack total if charged by several; with two whips only the first gets Whipcrack)
basis: Plain hand weapon with no AP (like Club/Axe); book special rules transcribed as-is since Attacks do not double.

name: Man-catcher
rules: Capture (a model taken out of action by it is captured with no Serious Injury roll and locked in the Engine of Chaos; normal injury roll if no Engine of Chaos; large models and animals cannot be captured)
basis: Two-handed pole weapon without the +2 Strength of 2H weapons as the book gives User; no AP.

name: Mechanical suit
rules: +3 Movement, counts as Chaos armour, Sorcerer only (full price 225 gc)
basis: Chaos armour counted as Plate-class AV 4 (Plate/Ithilmar Chainmail 4); +3 M not doubled as Movement does not double.

name: Broadsword
rules: Strike last, Unwieldy (no second weapon or buckler, shield ok), Cannot Parry, counts as a sword for Expert Swordsman
basis: Sword body with User +1 like Morning Star/Flail; no AP, no Parry, Strike last as a 2H-style penalty.

name: Lance
rules: Mounted models only, +2 Strength on the charge only, Strike first on the charge
basis: No rules text found; classic Mordheim lance: +2 S on the charge, mounted only; modelled like Spear for Strike first. Price 20 gc in most lists, 40 gc in Imperial Outriders and Lustrian Reavers.

name: Kite shield
rules: AV 3 on foot, AV 2 while mounted (Bretonnian Knights only), cannot bring a save over 1+
basis: Book save 9+ on foot / natural 12 mounted modelled as Large Shield AV 3 on foot and Small Shield AV 2 mounted.

name: Shortsword
rules: Parry (1), enemy armour save +1 (natural 12 save if none), counts as a sword for Expert Swordsman
basis: Sword (Parry 1) with the book's armour-save bonus for the enemy; no sheet analogue so noted as a rule.

name: Disease Dagger
rules: Pair (+1 attack with two), enemy armour save +1 (natural 12 save if none), Infecting (natural 12 to hit infects; target must roll above Toughness on a D12 or take an automatic wound; undead and possessed immune)
basis: Dagger (User -1) with book armour bonus and Infecting; Toughness test written in d12 terms.

name: Censer
rules: +2 Strength in the first turn of combat only, Fog of Death (a model hit rolls a D12; above its Toughness is an automatic wound, natural 12 always wounds; the wielder also takes the test, wounded on a natural 12; undead and possessed immune)
basis: Two-handed flail-like weapon with first-turn +2 S (Flail-style, no AP); Toughness test in d12 terms.

name: Hedonist Whip
rules: Cannot be parried, Whipcrack (+1 Attack when charging; +1 Attack striking first against the charger when charged; max +1 Attack total if charged by several; with two whips only the first gets Whipcrack), Heroes only
basis: Same rules as Steel whip at 15 gc; kept as its own entry because the names differ.

name: Slaaneshi Man-Catcher
rules: Lock (on an unsaved wound no injury roll; enemy is knocked down and cannot stand or move away while in melee with the wielder unless by magic; no effect on large creatures or steeds; at end of battle captured as Serious Injury result 61 if still pinned, even a Henchman)
basis: Man-catcher with User +1 as the book; Lock transcribed since the sheet has no capture analogue.

name: Beastlash
rules: Reach (attacks up to 4" away), Beastbane (animals charged by or wishing to charge the wielder must first pass a Fear test), Beastmaster only (full cost 10 + D6 gc)
basis: Dagger-class weapon (User -1) with Reach; no AP.

name: Repeater Crossbow
rules: Double Shot, +1 AP
basis: No rules text found (PDF is scanned); crossbow-class repeater: S3 24", Double Shot like Throwing knives, +1 AP like Crossbow.

name: Dark Elf Blade
rules: +1 Crit result, Wicked Edge (injury roll of 2-4 is Stunned), upgrade to a sword or dagger that keeps its abilities (item text +20 gc)
basis: Sword/dagger upgrade; Critical Damage as Axe's +1 Crit result, list price 15 gc printed in warband list.

name: Sea Dragon Cloak
rules: AV 4 against missiles (full cost 50 + 2D6 gc)
basis: Book 5+ close combat / 4+ missiles; heavy-armour 5+ is Chainmail AV 3, so 4+ is one step up at AV 4.

name: Dwarf Axe
rules: +1 Crit result, +1 AP, Dwarves only
basis: No rules text found in the PDFs; Axe (+1 Crit result) upgraded by +1 AP given the 15 gc price against 5 gc.

name: Boss Pole
rules: Strike first (with -2 OS), Unwieldy (no dual wield, shield ok), the hero and Goblin henchmen within 6" ignore animosity
basis: Acts as a Spear per the book note; animosity rule added.

name: Throwing Weapons
rules: Skirmish (no pen move), H2H, Double Shot
basis: Generic throwing weapons modelled on Throwing knives (same 15 gc and range).

name: Double Barrelled Pistol
rules: Reload (2), +3 AP, H2H, Double-barrelled (fire one or both barrels; both barrels = one to-hit roll and separate wound rolls; after both reload 2 turns; brace 35 gc)
basis: Pistol (10", +3 AP, H2H) with the book double-barrelled rule; brace price 35 gc.

name: Double Barrelled Duelling Pistol
rules: Rifled (no malus long range), Reload (2), +3 AP, H2H, Double-barrelled (as Double Barrelled Pistol; brace 65 gc)
basis: Dueling Pistol (12", Rifled, +3 AP) with the double-barrelled rule.

name: Double Barrelled Handgun
rules: Reload (2), Steady Aim (move or shoot), +4 AP, Double-barrelled (as Double Barrelled Pistol)
basis: Handgun (32", Steady Aim, +4 AP) with the double-barrelled rule.

name: Repeater Pistol
rules: +3 AP, Fire Thrice (up to 3 shots, -2 to hit if more than one, later shots may target a model within 3" of previous), Experimental (misfire: any result other than BOOM! means jammed/must reload), Quick Reload (can always fire one shot; after multiple shots must skip a shooting phase), Not a Club (pistol in first round of combat only)
basis: Pistol (10", +3 AP) with book repeater rules; the -1 to hit doubled to -2.

name: Repeater Handgun
rules: Steady Aim (move or shoot), +4 AP, Fire Thrice (up to 3 shots, -2 to hit if more than one, later shots within 3" of previous target), Experimental (any result other than BOOM! = jammed/must reload), Slow Reload (reload takes a whole turn doing nothing)
basis: Handgun (32", +4 AP) with book repeater rules; -1 to hit doubled to -2.

name: Hand-Held Mortar
rules: Steady Aim (move or shoot), +4 AP, Scatter (on a miss the shot lands 2D6" in a random direction), Experimental (misfire as Repeater Handgun), Explosive Radius (target and all models within 1.5" of the landing point take a single S4 hit), Reload (2)
basis: Handgun-class gun at the book's 24" range (not the sheet's 32" handgun) with Scatter and Explosive Radius; Reload (2) added as Prepared Shot.

name: Pigeon Bombs
rules: Steady Aim (move or shoot), +4 AP, Explosive Radius (as Hand-Held Mortar), Tempermental (do not use BS; roll D12: 9-12 hits target, 3-8 explodes harmlessly, 1-2 explodes in the bearer's hands, bearer and all within 1.5" take a S4 hit), Pigeon Roost (one purchase lasts the whole game and is replenished each game)
basis: Mortar-class explosive with unlimited range; d6 roll 5+ mapped to 9+, 3-4 to 5-8 and 1-2 to 1-2.

name: Throwing Axe
rules: Skirmish (no pen move), +1 Crit result
basis: Javelin range/Skirmish with Axe's +1 Crit result; 15 gc like Throwing knives.

name: Main Gauche
rules: Parry (1), enemy armour save +1
basis: Sword (Parry 1) with the book's armour bonus for the enemy, like Shortsword.

name: Toughened Leathers
rules: Combinable only with helmet or buckler (not shield), cannot be given away or sold
basis: Works like light armour at 5 gc: Gambeson AV 1.

name: Bone Helmet
rules: 4+ stun save
basis: Helmet (AV 0, 4+ stun save) at the same 10 gc.
